text: 2026-05-21 schedule: Golf starts at 12:00 AM ET with PGA Tour, Champions Tour, and DP World Tour events. MLB has a full slate all day, then Cavs-Knicks, Valkyries-Liberty, Tempo-Lynx, and Canadiens-Hurricanes all at 8:00 PM ET. Late MLB: Braves-Marlins, Blue Jays-Yankees, A’s-Angels, Rockies-Dbacks. Watch on ESPN+, MLB.TV, ESPN, TNT/truTV/Max, Amazon Prime, WNBA League Pass, and local broadcasts. Follow @any_and_all_sports.
